meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides SHEIN app prompts, coupon strips, and pop-up layers; blur or hide product photos; hide prices
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, shein.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): Branch app banner `#branch-app` 1, coupon strips 2, promo hero 1, dialog layer `.one-pass-dialog` 1 (empty; its content is not verified), product photos 16, prices 16. The promo hero selector was removed because the real fixture shows the carousel contains product cards marked `data-keep`; hiding the wrapper would hide wanted shopping content. The search suggestion carousel inside the search box (`search-term__wrapper`) is also deliberately untouched.

NOT verified: product and category pages, the desktop layout, the cart and sign-up flow, the original cookie and ad rules (no banner appeared), exact content of the pop-up layer.
